selftext:
# 0•X — BCH Prototype

# A ship that's a real, understandable machine — with a genuinely programmable 16-bit computer at its heart.

You wake aboard a small ship. Its power, cooling, air, and propulsion are simulated systems that actually work and actually fail — and the computer that runs it is a real emulated processor you program in its own Forth operating system, live on the CRT. Power it on, learn it, break it, and fix it: authored failure scenarios you diagnose from the inside and solve two distinct ways — one at the terminal, one by hand.

    In the early 2000s humanity discovered the Field — an impossible technology, understood only well enough to use. A few years later came worse news: an extinction event Earth could not survive.
    There was room to save only a fraction — a few hundred million, chosen largely by lottery. The evacuation fleet scattered on deliberately different courses, each ship a civilization seed carrying the means to begin again, its passengers asleep in Field suspension.
    Then Field transit went catastrophically wrong. An interval passed that no one can measure — the surviving records disagree, and the true figure is not something the living can know. They call it The Dream. The sleepers woke far downstream of their own history, into an old, cooling cosmos where the last long-lived stars are burning down.
    Only a handful of Earth's ships are known to have reached this region. Local civilization has stood here for some twelve centuries. Thousands of the Earth-born are still under — Dreamers; those who wake are the Awakened; those born since, Naturals. Earth is at once unimaginably ancient and living memory.

**You are newly Awakened. The ship is yours to understand.**  


**0•X is A hard-science-fiction game about operating a spacecraft that is actually a machine.**  
**The ship's power, cooling, air, and propulsion are simulated systems that genuinely work and genuinely fail — and the computer that runs it is a real emulated 16-bit processor you program in its own Forth operating system, live on the CRT.**



[The A16 is a 16-bit processor. Everything it touches — every register, every memory cell, every value — is a 16-bit word. Memory is addressed by the word, not by the byte: address 0, address 1, address 2 are successive 16-bit cells. There are 65,536 of them.](https://preview.redd.it/n9llakf2xwth1.png?width=1280&format=png&auto=webp&s=f1b9a168b7309d0c430285b8c28190ee11e1de1e)
